title: CYBRIK digest-bound delegation chain v1
description: An ordered chain of digest-bound delegation grants (ADR-0006 E3), e.g. analyst→agent then approver→agent-for-action. Each grant is bound to its predecessor by digest, so the chain cannot be reordered, truncated, or spliced without detection. This descriptor carries NO raw token or credential (ADR-0004 F5); executors never receive it (only single-use scoped credentials). The chain is referenced from envelopes via the scalar `delegationref` (its chain_digest) and embedded/summarized in execution receipts. Status: PROPOSED — NOT ACCEPTED.

chain_digest.description: Digest over the ordered list of grant_digest values. This is the value referenced by the envelope `delegationref` and by receipts.

tenant_id.description: Tenant the entire chain is scoped to. Every grant MUST share this tenant; cross-tenant grants are invalid.

grants.description: Ordered grants, index 0 = root delegation. grant[n].parent_digest MUST equal grant[n-1].grant_digest; grant[0].parent_digest MUST be null.

grant_digest.description: Digest over this grant's canonical content (all fields except grant_digest itself).

parent_digest.description: grant_digest of the preceding grant, or null for the root grant.

audience.description: Intended relying party that may accept this grant, e.g. 'cybrik.fabric.control-plane'. A grant presented to any other audience MUST be rejected (confused-deputy defense).

purpose.description: Bound purpose, e.g. 'incident_investigation'. Authority is valid only for this purpose.

scope.description: What the subject may do under this grant. Empty arrays mean 'nothing granted at this level' (fail-closed), not 'everything'.

capabilities.description: Capability names (optionally digest-pinned) the subject may invoke.

resource_patterns.description: Server-resolvable resource scope patterns. Never client-asserted target identity.

max_risk_class.description: Highest risk class this grant authorizes. A downstream request above this class MUST be denied.

max_uses.description: Optional cap on how many times this grant may authorize an action.

separation_of_duties.description: If true, subject actor MUST differ from the acting/approving actor elsewhere in the flow.

expires_at.description: Hard expiry. Idempotent replay after expiry MUST NOT re-authorize (strategy 05 §11.4).
